definitions.explanation: A product that has been recently developed or released for sale.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}が{発売|はつばい}された。
{来月|らいげつ}、{新商品|しんしょうひん}の{説明会|せつめいかい}がある。
examples.english: There's a new product presentation next month.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{春|はる}になると、コンビニには{新商品|しんしょうひん}がたくさん{並|なら}ぶ。
examples.english: Every spring, convenience stores line up with lots of new products.

notes:
{新商品|しんしょうひん} combines {新|しん} (new) + {商品|しょうひん} (product/merchandise). It refers to a recently developed or released product.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}を{開発|かいはつ}する: to develop a new product
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}を{発売|はつばい}する: to release a new product
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}の{紹介|しょうかい}: introduction of a new product
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}が{出|で}る: a new product comes out
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}を{試|ため}す: to try a new product

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新製品|しんせいひん}: new product (emphasizes manufacturing; used for electronics, industrial products)
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}: new product (emphasizes commerce; used for retail, food, consumer goods)

USAGE:
Very common in business, retail, and marketing contexts. Convenience stores and food companies frequently promote {新商品|しんしょうひん}.
